messages:
maria: Quick sync — we're a week out from launch. Need final confirmations on SLA, docs, support routing, monitoring dash, pricing guardrails. Can owners call out blockers? :eyes:
kevin: SLA draft is up: https://redwood.internal/sla-draft — targets: p99 latency 200ms for small models, 500ms for large. Need legal signoff on penalties. Owner: @kevin. Status: draft -> in review. :white_check_mark:
priya: Docs: runbook + API reference done. Still missing examples for Private deployment and Dedicated quotas. Owner: @priya. ETA: Tue EOD.
david: Observability: dashboards exist for latency/cost per model. Missing alert thresholds and concise playbook steps. Will ask SRE to propose thresholds. Owner: @david.
maria: Support question — who owns oncall routing for "model degradation" vs "capacity exhaustion"? We need explicit pages and SLO references in the runbook. @ben?
ben: Yep. I'll add routing and paging rules. Also proposing a 72h enterprise support SLA entry in the docs. Will PR. :thumbsup:
priya: Pricing: default metered tiers ready. Need a safety cap knob for self-serve customers and an automated billing alert for >75% monthly spend. Who owns billing UI? @ken?
ken: I can add cap toggle; small frontend + backend work. ETA Thu. Will stub the API so pricing can test.
maria: Outstanding blockers list (owners + minimal acceptance criteria):
 - SLA: legal signoff + published table + fallback policy (owner: kevin)
 - Docs: example snippets for Private/Dedicated + runbook link + quickstart (owner: priya)
 - Monitoring: alert thresholds + 2-step runbook + oncall routing configured (owner: david/ben)
 - Pricing: cap toggle + published thresholds + billing alert + billing UI merged (owner: ken/priya)
maria: I'll run a 15m checkpoint tomorrow 10:30 PT. Ping here when you update. :calendar:
oncall-bot: Reminder scheduled for 10:30am PT tomorrow. :bell:
kevin: Noted. Sharing legal thread next; will highlight penalty language and fallback policy.
david: I'll propose thresholds by EOD today and attach sample Grafana alert rules. :gear:
priya: Examples PR in review: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/482 — will merge once legal OK, then I'll update quickstart.
ben: Routing PR opened -> https://git.internal/routing/pr/134. Ops gave thumbs up on paging.
maria: Thanks team. If anything slips, call for a 10m firecall. :pray:
